items.title: Pay operating cost back-payment (Nebenkosten-Nachzahlung)
items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie den offenen Betrag bis spätestens 11.12.2026 aus.
items.computation: The letter prints an explicit calendar due date, 11.12.2026, for the outstanding amount, so no period calculation is needed. 11 December 2026 falls on a Friday, so no weekend/holiday adjustment applies.

warnings: The billing period ran from 01.07.2024 to 30.06.2025, so under §556 Abs. 3 BGB the landlord generally had to send this statement within 12 months of the period's end, i.e. by 30.06.2026; this statement is dated 18.11.2026, almost five months late. This may mean the landlord has forfeited the right to claim the back-payment (Ausschlussfrist) unless they can show they were not responsible for the delay — it is worth checking this with a tenants' association (Mieterverein) before paying.

The letter was hand-delivered into the mailbox by the caretaker rather than sent by post with an authority-style delivery fiction; the stated drop-off date and time (18.11.2026, 9 Uhr) is taken as the actual delivery date, which also starts the tenant's own 12-month period (§556 Abs. 3 S.5 BGB, i.e. until roughly 18.11.2027) to raise objections to the accounting.
